title: Re-bless cause-documentation says "the map changes every frame" but the map is seed-static and cached
evidence:
+// deliberately — the map changes every frame (cause-documented in the PR).
---
+untouched; T2 goldens re-bless deliberately (the map changes every frame). The §2 palette
---
+- **Goldens:** full deliberate T2 re-bless (the map changes every frame — 76 frames,
---
+// dims → byte-identical cells, pinned by the harness palcheck map-identity
detail: The map is byte-identical per seed and cached in View; goldens changed because the map now exists, not because it varies per frame. The recorded cause misstates the mechanism.
recommended_fix: Reword to "the map is now present on every frame"; a per-frame-varying map would actually violate the seed-pinned identity contract.

title: palcheck hard-codes the water/coast/park RGB triples, duplicating palette.json and both palette.odin copies
location: harness/palcheck.odin:1d block vs data/palette.json vs app/render/palette.odin
detail: The token values now live in four places. Art tuning via palette.json (ODN-5) desynchronizes the gate, which then scans colors that no longer render and fails.
recommended_fix: Load the palcheck scan colors from the same palette source the renderer uses, or generate them from palette.json at gate time instead of pinning literals.
